title: A few days somewhere else
subject_and_argument: A short Scandinavian break; ease of ordinary systems and unfamiliar conversations, without pretending four days prove a theory.
reusable_ideas: The jellyfish exchange; good transport barely registers; unfamiliar places produce unfamiliar conversations.
platform_suitability: X primary; LinkedIn only the bounded service observation
sensitivities: Keep travel in the past; no claims about whole countries from a short visit. Beach photo optional, no need to expose family.

title: Drawing a future we haven’t built yet
subject_and_argument: Planning the home exposes incompatible futures; a useful plan preserves options without committing to everything drawn.
reusable_ideas: Paper is generous; a line hides the difference between a wish and a commitment; orchard time versus construction sequence.
sensitivities: Do not imply the pool or extension was built. Avoid property-location details and floor-plan images.

title: I didn't put my screen up
subject_and_argument: At an internal hackathon the author deliberately resisted driving the work; individual AI-assisted capability can crowd out team learning.
reusable_ideas: The HDMI decision; I will just do it can be about me; increased capability creates more chances to interfere.
platform_suitability: LinkedIn primary; X standalone restraint angle
sensitivities: Internal event: keep no team, project, people, outcome figures or employer identifiers. Positive observation, not a claim to a leadership model.

title: The hard bit after starting
subject_and_argument: The first missed Friday exposed a routine dependent on novelty; a surviving process made return cheaper.
reusable_ideas: Writing continued while publishing stopped; worthwhile competing demands; design a route back after a missed week.
sensitivities: Avoid recycling prior LinkedIn habits post verbatim; history not this week's event. Omit mortgage details.

title: The software factory is already here. Sort of.
subject_and_argument: Using agents to build and investigate systems makes engineering judgement and its development more visible.
reusable_ideas: A quick fix still needs diagnosis; agents help a practitioner return to the tools; faster creation of future legacy; show evidence before accepting done.
sensitivities: Avoid exposing data-portal weakness or operational configuration details; no generic speed multiplier. Do not identify a client or promote TIFT.

title: The things that never became data
subject_and_argument: Personalised AI can read recorded traces while relationship meaning may never have been captured.
reusable_ideas: More context is still context that exists; words are not the meaning; capture everything may change the exchange.
sensitivities: Doug Scott is a source, not Phil origin of all ideas; preserve attribution if directly following his argument. Avoid re-amplifying the final Grandad conversation by default.

title: What I’m reading, and what I’m noticing
subject_and_argument: Reading across Bostrom, Fuller and political/system texts reveals connections that change with the reader.
reusable_ideas: Books can remain useful without agreement; rereading meets a changed reader; owl humour; a reading path need not be designed.
sensitivities: Distinguish reading from rereading and completed from ongoing. Avoid current Musk claims or presenting authors' hypotheses as settled facts.

title: When a prototype becomes a service
subject_and_argument: A request to host an application exposes the promise made when users depend on a prototype.
reusable_ideas: Support inherits more than hosting; useful experiments need a route to yes; accidental adoption hides continuing work.
platform_suitability: LinkedIn primary; X concise service distinction
sensitivities: Keep application, builder, data and organisation anonymous. Honour value of experiment and avoid implying the existing request is unresolved now.

title: When the publishing system starts becoming me
subject_and_argument: A personal publishing system records editorial decisions but must let its author contradict learned preferences.
reusable_ideas: Readable can still feel wrong; a small observation need not be a framework; todays edit outranks yesterdays pattern.
sensitivities: Do not repeat the Anthropic departure or extinction-risk news without new primary-source verification. Link useful for actual system detail, no promise the model is the author.

title: After the disappointments
subject_and_argument: A son wins a title after previous disappointments; the photograph shows the result but not the return to training.
reusable_ideas: Pride preceded the belt; parents can support but cannot compete; the teammate in the photograph.
platform_suitability: X primary; occasional LinkedIn with restraint
sensitivities: Family and teammate visibility; permission for renewed photo amplification. Do not invent sporting details.

title: Building for an organisation that will disappear
subject_and_argument: Designing data foundations during LGR; present stewardship must preserve genuine choices for successors.
reusable_ideas: Temporary is not disposable; a shared platform distributes power; exit as a real choice; transition and permanent architectures answer different questions.
sensitivities: Names employer and intended future structures; verify current status before topical framing. Avoid implying agreed policy.
recommended_forms: Bounded practitioner argument; diagram only if useful

title: On building things that last
subject_and_argument: Family, failure and work shape durable foundations; gratitude acknowledges the whole journey.
reusable_ideas: Fatherhood at 20; ordinary repeated decisions; visible outcomes conceal foundations.
sensitivities: Family and named inter-council setting; keep personal material proportionate. Overlaps achievement/persistence pieces.

title: I could do without that
subject_and_argument: An unwanted birthday outing becomes an evening the author needed; family changes and Lauren's contribution become visible.
reusable_ideas: Treating loved ones as interruptions; family grows through partners; visible achievements rely on less visible effort.
sensitivities: Partner and family relationships; avoid amplifying private complications or photos without renewed judgement. Never say birthday happened this week.

title: Never too late to make your parents proud
subject_and_argument: Returning to formal study after a career interrupts established identity; graduation also returns the adult to being somebody's child.
reusable_ideas: Learning after doing; experience can be accumulated habit; standing between parents in graduation robes.
sensitivities: Rejected-promotion narrative and self-assessment are sensitive; choose education or parents angle without workplace grievance. Photo needs reuse judgement.

title: Not conditioned for the distance
subject_and_argument: Rehabilitation and a relative's ultramarathon distinguish possessing advice from developing capability.
reusable_ideas: Understanding rehabilitation did not do the exercises; organisations practise habits; stopping need not be weakness.
sensitivities: Current article says 66.7 miles; older conversations used a different figure. Do not repeat either without checking original evidence. Health details and relatives account; no advice.

title: Service as software
subject_and_argument: Testing agents on familiar work suggests execution friction falls while judgement, imagination and permission become more important.
reusable_ideas: Cheaper setup can release attention; faster output can simply create more demand; permission is part of the system.
sensitivities: 15 resembling 40 is expressly not measured productivity. Avoid this number and commercial service pitches. Recheck product claims before reuse.

title: Starting something new while returning to heritage
subject_and_argument: Beginning a Masters in Malta reconnects learning, family heritage and unexpected encounters.
reusable_ideas: Recognising Nanna in strangers mannerisms; new course at 46; headline development versus lived progress.
sensitivities: Private encounters, named lecturers and sensitive loss story; avoid amplifying these. Do not repeat unverified crematorium claim or national stereotypes.

title: The barriers are falling. The hard yards remain.
subject_and_argument: A designer brother builds with AI before learning conventional foundations; access changes but persistence and judgement remain.
reusable_ideas: GitHub before Git; learning order follows need; cognitive debt can create a reason to learn; expertise is not an entrance exam.
sensitivities: Brother and his project; check if naming/linking current site. Attribute cognitive debt if used, do not imply effortless AI replacement of expertise.

title: The Data Werewolf: why conversations about data are so difficult
subject_and_argument: Evidence becomes difficult when consequences meet identity, ownership and weak trust; shared understanding needs more than dashboards.
reusable_ideas: Selective scrutiny; governance teaches what data is for; data literacy runs both ways; leadership staying in the conversation.
sensitivities: Do not identify colleagues or imply all objections are resistance. Academic adaptation; internal later findings deliberately excluded.

title: The man bun had to go
subject_and_argument: A haircut after six years prompts a bounded observation about familiar appearance and changing identity.
reusable_ideas: Lockdown experiment became normal; keeping something from familiarity differs from choosing it; haircut did not validate consciousness theory.
sensitivities: Clearly retrospective haircut, not current event. Keep Harris book interpretation proportionate; no invented new self-transformation.

title: The trouble with knowing what you're doing
subject_and_argument: A classroom choice between two managers reveals self-recognition and tests how reasoning changes decisions.
reusable_ideas: Changed answer after new evidence; professional confidence differs from being right; knowledge, belief and assumption need distinguishing.
longevity: Evergreen classroom anecdote; organisational context current
sensitivities: Article also addresses recent disputed change proposals. Use only classroom account and omit grievance; full link would expose that wider context.

title: We’re all busy. That’s why the strategy matters.
subject_and_argument: Writing a strategy clarifies direction but does not itself create attention, authority or ownership.
reusable_ideas: Grammatical ownership versus practical ownership; strategy helps choose under pressure; writing coherence is not organisational coherence.
sensitivities: Board-member review episode can identify colleagues. Use general decision/ownership angle without disclosing consultation or implying employer endorsement.

title: Who is allowed to try?
subject_and_argument: Permission to experiment should survive a supportive manager's departure rather than operate as a lottery.
reusable_ideas: Official messages versus practical signals; unfinished work versus production service; the route to trying safely should be visible.
sensitivities: Avoid characterising current employer or naming managers. Overlaps prototype and service-as-software; space these ideas out.

title: Why study thinking?
subject_and_argument: Formal study can test experience and problem framing when plausible answers become cheap.
reusable_ideas: Questions worth asking; experience can become habit; study should do more than confirm prior beliefs.
sensitivities: Course has since begun: never reproduce offered-place wording as current. Avoid human-exclusive capability claims.

title: Crustafarianism and the question we’re not ready to ask about AI
subject_and_argument: An unpublished book experiment exposes how humans and agents jointly preserve meaning and culture.
reusable_ideas: Curation can help create the culture it records; external memory and identity; who authored the meaning?
sensitivities: Preserve distinction between generated selfhood claims and consciousness evidence. Third-party text, permissions and religious framing; book never commercially released.
recommended_forms: Reading/experiment note; short question with context

title: Friday came quickly
subject_and_argument: An intentionally small Friday note allows a full week to remain unfinished.
reusable_ideas: No formed thought is an acceptable outcome; a family Friday greeting was enough.
longevity: Context-bound; do not replay as this week
sensitivities: Contains private-family-message context. Do not manufacture a new busy Friday or reuse Happy Friday on Thursday.
recommended_forms: Tiny field note; permission not to post

title: Starting a blog
subject_and_argument: Writing creates a public record from scattered private thought, with evolution allowed.
reusable_ideas: A place to think out loud; capturing before polishing; a record of making and learning.
sensitivities: Do not present as a new blog launch. Overlaps publishing-system articles; use sparingly.

title: The cost of living
subject_and_argument: A poem examines how the language of economic necessity shapes what living seems to mean.
reusable_ideas: Living versus survival; time with children as an apparent extra; dignity reduced to accounts.
longevity: Evergreen creative work; Christmas references seasonal
sensitivities: Preserve poetry as poetry, not measured economics. Political/economic generalisations should not become unsupported statistical claims.
recommended_forms: Short attributed-to-self excerpt; link to poem

title: The house on both sides of the ledger
subject_and_argument: A self-built home is an achievement and continuing obligation; accounts cannot contain its full cost or value.
reusable_ideas: The extraordinary becomes ordinary life; equity is not cash; completion changes strain without erasing it.
sensitivities: Personal debt, advisers and friends private conversation. Do not give financial advice or expose balances, location or current household position.

title: What an interview makes you admit
subject_and_argument: A senior-role interview reveals underclaiming, mixed ambition and the gap between experience and retrieval of evidence.
reusable_ideas: A safe technical example hid leadership contribution; humility need not be vagueness; an answer improves after the interview.
sensitivities: Named council, unsuccessful application, succession inference and title frustration. Separate approval before amplification; avoid characterising panel or selected candidate.

title: What we inherit
subject_and_argument: A D-Day film and family military research make remembrance personal across generations.
reusable_ideas: Sons older than great-grandad at enlistment; survival enabled later generations; survivors also carried consequences.
platform_suitability: X primary; LinkedIn only by editorial choice
sensitivities: Remembrance timing has passed for launch. Historical details and external photographs require source/rights review before reuse; do not use film claims without verification.

title: The bit of government the public actually meets
subject_and_argument: A complaint and enforcement seem to run separately; correspondence speed cannot substitute for authority to change course.
reusable_ideas: Acknowledgement does not explain impact; whole-case visibility; clearer explanation during a challenge.
platform_suitability: X or LinkedIn after separate review
sensitivities: Open complaint in source; identifiable dispute risk even without organisation name. Hold amplification until Phil decides and checks present position.

title: The comfort of being busy
subject_and_argument: Urgent fixes can preserve recurring failures; youth coaching offers a specific contrast around consistent expectations, trust and responsibility.
reusable_ideas: A workaround acquires dependencies; root-cause work lacks immediate reward; clear constraints with freedom to make football decisions.
platform_suitability: LinkedIn primary; X football memory possible
sensitivities: Explicit dissatisfaction with current workplace leadership. Football photos show children. Hold general amplification; a football-only text extract is a separate human decision.
recommended_forms: Hold; bounded coaching memory after review

title: The space between incentives
subject_and_argument: Released technical capacity meets unchanged organisational incentives; busyness and structures can absorb the gains.
reusable_ideas: Capacity can go to strategy or more building; org charts miss knowledge flows; individually sensible behaviour can preserve inefficiency.
longevity: Evergreen concept; recent staffing context sensitive
sensitivities: Departing engineer and one-evening comparison risk identifying or diminishing a colleague. 100x is explicitly rhetorical, not measured. Hold whole-article promotion.
recommended_forms: Hold; separately review abstract capacity angle

title: What do we mean by “far right”?
subject_and_argument: A reading-led argument asks political labels to remain attached to identifiable beliefs and conduct.
reusable_ideas: A label should follow examination; connection is not equivalence; precision helps locate genuine extremism.
sensitivities: High context-collapse risk at 280 characters; earlier X thread was already developed. Check publication history and current factual sources; do not use a generic political teaser in launch.
recommended_forms: Hold; contextual thread only if explicitly selected

title: What England briefly brings together
subject_and_argument: A village-pub football memory explores temporary belonging without claiming lasting national unity.
reusable_ideas: Watching together versus alone; hope survives experience; a room can come together without a country agreeing.
sensitivities: Named 2026 results, match descriptions and linked match-centre routes need primary verification before redistribution. Published source is not sufficient factual verification. Pub photograph includes others.
recommended_forms: Hold pending factual check; later bounded memory
